commands:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin agent-control >/dev/null; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/payloads/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v3.sh > /tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v5.sh; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v5.sh')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("OUT='/tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v3'", "OUT='/tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v5'", 1)
old='APKSIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -type f -name apksigner 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n1)"\ntest -x "$APKSIGNER"'
new='APKSIGNER="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner"\nif [ ! -x "$APKSIGNER" ]; then APKSIGNER="$(command -v apksigner || true)"; fi\necho "apksigner=$APKSIGNER"\ntest -x "$APKSIGNER"'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected apksigner block not found')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
needle='adb -s "$SERIAL" shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n\nAPKSIGNER='
grants='adb -s "$SERIAL" shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\nCURRENT_USER="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am get-current-user | tr -d '\r')"\necho "current_android_user=$CURRENT_USER"\ntest "$CURRENT_USER" = 0\nfor permission in android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS; do\n  adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm grant "$PKG" "$permission" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\ndone\necho runtime_permissions_granted=1\n\nAPKSIGNER='
if needle not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected wake block not found')
s=s.replace(needle,grants,1)
s=s.replace('shell pm path "$PKG"', 'shell pm path --user 0 "$PKG"', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
chmod +x /tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v5.sh; /tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v5.sh
